# Error Handling Checklist: Arm The Accidentally-Advisory State Bookkeeping Checks

**Purpose**: Validate that ART-017's error-handling requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` workflow for the `error-handling` domain. It validates requirements writing, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are separate failure requirements documented for `in_progress_errors`, `duplicate_state_steps`, and `state_order_errors` under the exact `status-evidence` authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-003, Contract §Required Blocking Keys]
- [x] CHK002 Is success behavior documented for both the shared clean control and every tracked authority-matched workflow/state pair? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011-FR-012, Spec §SC-004-SC-005]
- [x] CHK003 Is full-report emission required even when a selected status-evidence problem makes the scoped command fail? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Contract §Exit Code Contract]
- [x] CHK004 Are legacy coverage findings required to remain report-visible and nonblocking under `status-evidence`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-006, Contract §Required Blocking Keys]
- [x] CHK005 Are malformed states containing multiple diagnostics covered without permitting fail-fast loss of the remaining report? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Report Shape Contract]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is failure quantified as process exit code `1` for each isolated ART-017 invariant under the exact `--rule status-evidence` invocation? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003, Contract §Command, Contract §Exit Code Contract]
- [x] CHK007 Is clean success quantified as exit code `0` under the same scoped invocation used by every negative control? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-004, Quickstart §Targeted GREEN Check]
- [x] CHK008 Is tracked-pair success tied to exact repo-relative workflow authority rather than directory adjacency alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012-FR-013, Contract §Workflow/State Pair Corpus Contract]
- [x] CHK009 Is “full report” defined through stable metadata fields, existing problem-key names, and list-valued diagnostics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-007, Contract §Report Shape Contract]
- [x] CHK010 Is it clear that scoped rule selection changes exit authority without filtering non-member diagnostics from the emitted JSON? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Report Shape Contract]

## Failure Causality & Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the other two ART-017 problem lists required to remain empty in each isolated negative control? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK012 Does each isolated negative control require every unrelated pre-existing `status-evidence` gated key to remain empty, proving the target ART-017 key—not another gated finding—is the reason for exit `1`? [Failure Causality, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-003, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [x] CHK013 Do rule membership, intent verdicts, and failure expectations consistently move together for exactly the three ART-017 keys? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001-FR-006, Research §Rule membership and intent verdicts]
- [x] CHK014 Do the spec and contract consistently preserve nonblocking behavior for `missing_state_prefixes` and `missing_state_post_items` while still reporting them? [Consistency, Spec §SC-006, Contract §Required Blocking Keys]
- [x] CHK015 Is a report-level `status: fail` from non-member diagnostics distinguishable from the scoped process exit result so consumers do not infer the wrong gate outcome? [Consistency, Contract §Exit Code Contract, Contract §Report Shape Contract, Data Model §Guard Report]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can each newly blocking invariant be measured independently by exit code, target-list population, and isolation assertions? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009-FR-010, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 Can shared clean-control success be measured objectively as one valid workflow/state pair returning exit `0`? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK018 Can tracked-pair clean behavior be measured objectively as 100% of authority-matched pairs returning success with no mismatched or synthesized pair included? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Data Model §Workflow/State Pair]
- [x] CHK019 Can full-report preservation be measured using the same top-level field set and diagnostic-key set before and after the authority change? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Contract §Report Shape Contract]
- [x] CHK020 Can the “0 additional advisory keys” boundary be measured against explicit status-evidence membership and intent records? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001-SC-002, Data Model §Rule Intent Record]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are primary clean, isolated exception, multi-diagnostic exception, legacy-advisory, and tracked-corpus scenarios all represented in the requirements? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-003-SC-006]
- [x] CHK022 Are workflows with missing, untracked, mismatched, or synthetic adjacent state explicitly excluded from clean-pair evidence rather than treated as failures of the scoped rule? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012-FR-013, Contract §Workflow/State Pair Corpus Contract]
- [x] CHK023 Is generated-artifact failure handling bounded to regeneration and verification rather than hand-edited recovery paths? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Structure Decision, Quickstart §Release Artifact Refresh]
- [x] CHK024 Are final-integration failure risks addressed by requiring latest-main rebase, artifact regeneration, docs checks, and full-suite proof if ART-008 lands first? [Dependencies, Spec §PR Review Packet Requirements, Quickstart §Final Integration Boundary]

## Notes

- Remediation loop 1 closed one failure-causality gap by requiring every non-target status-evidence-selected key to remain empty in each isolated negative control.
